## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (Energy, Healthcare, Financials leading) but major large-cap divergences (multiple big names showing 1W vs 1M mismatch); Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +10.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +31.64%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate: VTR (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +20.33%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: TXN (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -8.52%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -17.23%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Utilities also lagging (Materials 11 stocks, Utilities 10 stocks) with sector returns negative.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +6.99% | 1M: +14.11%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.87% | 1M: +6.28%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TXN (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -1.00%) BELOW TREND, MS (1W: -4.95% | 1M: -3.03%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -8.52%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -8.05%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology and pockets of Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND; watch for major divergence among large caps (META, V, JNJ, DHR showing 1W/1M mismatch) — tactical risk of trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak: AAPL (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND but NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND; Technology showing sector weakness overall (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Internal rotation: JPM (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +6.63%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +8.73%) CORRECTION, GS (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -1.00%) BELOW TREND — Financials generally positive but mixed leadership across banks and cards.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive but selective: UNH (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.98% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND while ISRG (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -13.94%) BELOW TREND and DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) CORRECTION — sector breadth positive but dispersion rising.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Energy exposure given recent leadership and breadth, reduce exposure to weaker Technology names showing sustained below-trend action, and monitor trend-exhaustion names (META, V, JNJ, DHR) for confirmation before scaling core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND — news-driven momentum; ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND — EU approval catalyst; MPC (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +31.64%) ABOVE TREND — energy cyclical strength. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND — watch downside continuation, TXN (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -17.23%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.27% | 10 stocks) and Healthcare (1W: +1.81% | 17 stocks) — both showing strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.13% | 24 stocks) and Materials (1W: -0.92% | 11 stocks) — watch for continued weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim the 1M highs would signal deeper pullback; AAPL (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — hold of recent 1M support would sustain tech leadership; JPM (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +6.63%) ABOVE TREND — above-monthly pivot would reinforce Financials strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (+80): PayPal takeover/strategic headlines; PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. MMM (+80): strong Q2 and raised guidance; MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND — price confirming. ABBV (+75): EU approval catalyst; ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND — confirming accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (-50): GLP-1 lawsuit headlines; LLY (1W: +1.98% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines but price still confirming, watch for follow-through (divergence). DHR (-45): soft segment headline; DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +10.09%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major large-cap divergences and negative tech sentiment — watch for trend breaks and confirmatory follow-through.
